definition: to happen as a planned event
description: A wedding ceremony inside a tall Victorian glasshouse full of palms. A bride in a long satin dress and a groom in a cream suit walk hand in hand down a grass aisle away from an arch of white roses, raising their free arms in joy. Bridesmaids in champagne dresses dance beside them at first, and rows of guests in suits and dresses cheer, clap and hug on both sides and watch from a white spiral staircase and balcony. Soft evening light falls through the glass roof.
